topic.title: Etch A Sketch App
topic.description: A keyboard-controlled drawing app using W/A/S/D keys to move the turtle and C to clear the screen. A complete interactive turtle application.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Binding multiple keys to different turtle actions and using screen.clearscreen() to reset the drawing.
learningNotes.challenges: Ensuring key bindings do not interfere with each other and that the screen remains responsive.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add pen color selection with number keys and an undo feature.

files.description: WASD-controlled turtle drawing with clear function.
